qa_pairs.question: What is the primary function of the Metrix portal for Alliance users?
qa_pairs.answer: The Metrix portal is a website designed for Alliance users to gather information on compute nodes and management servers. Its main function is to interactively generate data, enabling users to track their resource usage, including CPUs, GPUs, memory, and filesystems, in real-time.

qa_pairs.question: Which specific Metrix portal URLs are provided for Alliance users?
qa_pairs.answer: Alliance users can access the Metrix portal through these specific URLs: Rorqual (https://metrix.rorqual.alliancecan.ca), Narval (https://portail.narval.calculquebec.ca), and Nibi (https://portal.nibi.sharcnet.ca).

qa_pairs.question: What types of information can Alliance users monitor under the 'Scientific software' tab of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the 'Scientific software' tab in the Metrix portal, Alliance users can view graphs that display the most frequently used software, along with their associated CPU cores and GPUs.
